Enamel camping kettle, 1.2 litre

£34.00
In stock, ships in 2 days
18 reviews

A pressed steel kettle with a glass enamel coat inside and out, made to sit straight on a gas ring, a wood stove or the embers of a fire. The folding handle stays cool enough to hold, and the spout has a hinged cap that keeps ash out.

It boils a litre of water in about six minutes on a small camping stove. The enamel does not hold flavours, so the same kettle can be used for tea, coffee and soup on the same trip.

Capacity1.2 litres
Weight480 g
MaterialSteel with glass enamel
Base diameter14 cm
Suitable forGas, wood, coals, induction
